menu.logoutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.

off.label: Sign-in is off
off.hint: Sign-in is turned off by the auth: off setting. Everyone has administrator rights, except for revealing card numbers and secrets.
off.text: Everyone has administrator rights, except for revealing card numbers and secrets

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.text: Your account has no Threadline role. Contact the administrator of the sign-in service (OIDC).

error.title: Sign-in failed
error.denied: The sign-in service refused the sign-in.
error.unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Please try again a little later.
error.config: Sign-in is configured incorrectly. Contact your administrator.
error.clock: The clocks of the server and the sign-in service differ. Contact your administrator.
error.state: The response from the sign-in service is out of date or invalid. Please sign in again.
error.unknown: Could not sign in. Please try again.

loggedOut.title: You have signed out
loggedOut.providerUnreachable: The sign-in service did not respond: your session at the OIDC provider may still be active, and the next sign-in may not ask for a password.

done.title: Signed in
done.text: Go back to the tab you were working in.

lost.title: The session was not saved
lost.text: The browser did not keep the session after sign-in. Check that cookies are allowed for this address and try again.

expired.title: Your session has expired
expired.text: Your input is still here. Sign in in a new tab and come back to save it.
expired.login: Sign in in a new tab

closed.title: Section unavailable
closed.text: This section is not available to your role.
